embeds.title: Example v2.6.0
embeds.description:
### Added
- Maintenance windows can now repeat every week.
- The simulator can inject a slow bearing fault ([#431](https://github.com/example-org/example/issues/431)).

### Fixed
- The edge gateway no longer drops readings when the link returns.

Full changelog: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/example-org/example/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

[Read the full notes](https://github.com/example-org/example/releases/tag/v2.6.0)
